source_record.description:
Tasks

Job Description: AWS AI Solutions Architect

Base Location: UK

Travel: Travel across Europe (Germany, Denmark, Netherlands, France, Spain, Switzerland)

Fulltime- Permanent

Solution Architecture & AI Innovation

  • Design end-to-end AWS solutions covering AI/ML/GenAI, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and modernization.
  • Lead PoC and demo creation including GenAI, Copilot-style, and agentic AI demonstrations.
  • Define scalable, secure, high-performance architectures aligned with AWS best practices.
  • Build PoCs, MVPs, and customer demonstrations
  • Develop GenAI applications using Amazon Bedrock and AWS AI services
  • Design and implement production-grade AI solutions on AWS
  • Lead customer workshops and architecture discussions
  • Guide engineering teams through deployment and scale-up

Requirements

Core skillset is Full Stack architect with React + Java SpringBoot + AWS + GENAI (AWS Bedrock, Strands SDK and Agentcore).
